summary.text: David A. Clemens is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 16 (West Fargo) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists David A. Clemens's service as "Senate since 2017". The member page lists David A. Clemens's committee assignments as including Transportation (Chairman) and the Human Services standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists David A. Clemens's occupation as Owner, Clemens Transport.
It lists education as BS, Industrial Engineering, NDSU.
It lists military service as US Army, Vietnam Veteran.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Chairman, Republican Party District 16 (2012-2016); VFW; American Legion; NRA; Vietnam Veterans of America.
David A. Clemens is listed as married to Jody with 4 children.
